name: University of Surrey

programs.title: Business, Economics, Law and Social Sciences
programs.summary: Choose this route if you have ambitions of studying in the areas of tourism, hospitality, business, law and politics.

programs.title: Computing, Engineering and Physical Sciences
programs.summary: This is the choice for you if you hope to study a degree in fields related to engineering, science or mathematics.

programs.title: Life Sciences
programs.summary: Interested in biology, chemistry and food science-related subjects? Choose this route to progress to your undergraduate degree at Surrey.

programs.title: Hospitality and Tourism Management
programs.summary: Choose this route if you have ambitions for a career in hospitality or tourism management, an exciting and fast-growing sector.

programs.title: Management, Finance, Hospitality and Tourism
programs.summary: Interested in economics, accounting and finance, or marketing management? Choose this route to progress to masters study at Surrey.

description: The International Study Centre is located on campus at the University of Surrey, in the town of Guildford. Living in Guildford you will find over 100 places to eat and drink, with a variety of restaurants and cafes to suit every budget.
